paras: Application: Toyota GR Supra (MK5) 2020+ – B58 3.0L turbo only Part Type: PCV Fluid Lock oil catch can kit Part Number: 20-0749-FL

The Radium 20-0749-FL PCV catch can kit runs inline between the ventilation (PCV) valve and the intake pipe on the B58-powered GR Supra, capturing oil and water condensation carried in the crankcase gases before they reach the intake. Separating oil and water condensation from the crankcase gases keeps oil build-up out of the intake, intercooler, throttle body and intake manifold. This effectively raises octane, can improve performance from cleaner inlet air and can lower hydrocarbon emissions, and the closed system keeps oil vapour out of the cabin.
hl: Fluid Lock: Patented Fluid Lock mechanism stops the reservoir overfilling and traps collected fluid until the can is emptied
Large Ports: 10AN ORB inlet and outlet ports
Dipstick: O-ring sealed dipstick to check the fluid level
Pressure Sealed: No extra inline check valve is required
ft: Radium Engineering PCV Fluid Lock Catch Can Kit for Toyota GR Supra A90 / A91 2019+
